title: 2D Offset Pass starts at: one contour-parallel ring set for Auto, Inside and Outside; the choice changes only the start point and the ring order

body:
Part of #3741. The other sub-issues of #3741 build on this one.

## The maintainer's rule

His words (chat, 2026-11-23): "The only thing that differs and inside and outsided strategy is actually where the tool starts.. inside the bounding box, or outsided the bounding box. Why there is different cut strategies between outside, inside and auto (which is insane) is strange.."

Also: "contour-parallel offset rings from the outside in toward the selected contour" (the #3741 body, Expected).

## What happens

"Pass starts at" selects one of three different ring planners. Each gives a different set of rings.

- Dispatch: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/level_rings.rs:101-120` (`ring_plan_ramped`).
- Auto: `pocket_plan.rs:20-36` -> `waterscan.rs:62` (`waterline_passes`). It offsets the whole cutter-centre area from both edges. In a long narrow band the loops collapse to thin back-and-forth loops. The maintainer sees "zigzag or raster-like moves in the long side areas".
- Outside: `level_rings.rs:188-203`. The rings are offsets of the outer edge only (the stock box). The part cuts each ring into open pieces that end on the part wall.
- Inside: `level_rings.rs:169-187`. The rings are offsets of the part, grown out. They are parallel to the selected contour.
- Other start-side switches: `pocket.rs:308-347` (`cleared_links`, `ramp_starts`), `pocket_avoid.rs:147, 209-210`, `pocket_hsm_start.rs:42-63`, `pocket_hsm.rs:61-62, 92-100`, `level_order.rs:143-145`, `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:982, 1102` (the stock band goes to the plan only when the start is not Auto).

Readings (synthetic dog-bone part in an 80 x 50 stock box, D8, stepover 2, one level; see the #3741 research comment):

| Pass starts at | floor runs | runs that end on the part wall |
|---|---|---|
| Outside | 14 | 14 |
| Inside | 8 | 0 |
| Auto | 7 | 1 |

This started with #3353 (`e313aa663`). It is not a regression of #3577.

## Fix approach

1. Make one ring set for the three choices: the contour-parallel rings, at the distances `off + k * stepover` from the selected contour (the part), cut by the cutter-centre area of the stock box. This is the ring set of the Inside branch today.
2. The rings that the stock edge cuts are open pieces. Keep them in the same set.
3. Inside walks the rings from the part out (k up). Outside walks them from the stock edge in (k down).
4. Auto selects one of the two start points. It does not select a different planner. Recommended rule: Auto = Outside when the stock box is larger than the cutter-centre area on all sides (open air around the stock), else Inside. Record the rule in `docs/decisions/`.
5. Remove the Auto-set fallback of `level_rings.rs:113-118` for the start sides, or make it give the same ring set. A leftover area gets clean-up rings of the same set, not a different planner.
6. Delete the start-side switches that only exist because the ring sets differ (`cleared_links`, the dead-end marks). The linking and entry sub-issues of #3741 replace them.

Check the other users of `level_pieces` and `plan_passes` (2D Pocket, `pocket_avoid`, the 3-D pocket levels). #3743 reviews all 2D ring planners. This issue is the 2D Offset slice of that review.

## Pins (red first)

- `inside_and_outside_cut_the_same_rings`: on the dog-bone part, Inside and Outside give the same multiset of rings (each ring as a closed or open polyline, compared within 1 um after a start-point and direction normalisation). Only the ring order and the start point differ.
- `auto_is_inside_or_outside`: Auto gives exactly the path of Inside or of Outside on the same part.
- `outside_rings_follow_the_part`: on the dog-bone part, no Outside floor run ends on the part wall, except at a ring that the stock edge cuts.
- `fig8_start_sides_have_no_crossing`: on the committed `testdata/models/fig8.step` (through the existing test loaders), Inside and Outside give no `Warning::Crossing`. (The maintainer's Inside run gave 414 Crossing warnings on a private model. The synthetic part gives 0.)

Effort `max`: a new ring planner contract for three choices, under the safety floor (it changes posted G-code).

Done means: the four pins are green; Auto, Inside and Outside of 2D Offset call one ring planner; the decision file records the Auto rule.
